top_signals.title: Deep Dive Into The US' Critical Minerals Investment
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Senior Economic Statecraft Reporter Joe Deaux joins Tim Stenovec and Kristine Aquino for a one-hour special of Businessweek Daily to answer all your questions about rare earths and the $3 Billion US investment in the critical minerals industry. Investigative Reporter Polly Mosendz discusses her report on how "Trump Is Rewriting Corporate Norms With 211-Mile Arctic Road." Plus, Gracelin Baskaran -- Director of Critical Minerals Security Program at CSIS -- breaks down the global viability of the rare earths trade. Then, Quince Street Strategy Principal Tripp Hornick talks about the domestic-side of the investment, and what it means for companies trying take advantage in a growing industry. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
